summary: Backend (8/8 pytest) + Frontend (Playwright) end-to-end verification of the careers application flow, WhatsApp float button, Certifications section, Navbar responsiveness (1280/1366/1920/1024), Home KPI strip and CTA band, plus /api/enquiries regression. All required behaviors work as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: ApplicationForm HTML5 `required` on discipline runs before onSubmit — the `Please attach your resume.` toast is only reached when all other required fields (name/email/phone/discipline) are filled. Not a bug per spec but worth noting: consider `noValidate` on <form> + explicit checks to give consistent custom toast messaging.

Optional: when the user removes an already-selected resume and re-picks the same filename, the hidden <input type=file> change event may not fire if the path is identical (browser behavior). A `input.value = ''` before `pickFile` (or on remove) would avoid this pitfall for keyboard users.

server.py: create_application accepts UploadFile.content_type from the client which is user-controllable. Type is validated (good), but consider also sniffing magic bytes for defense-in-depth (%PDF, PK\x03\x04 for docx, D0 CF 11 E0 for doc).
seed_data_creation: Test rows/files were created via qa-test*@example.com and cleaned up by test_zzz_cleanup (Mongo `applications`/`enquiries` docs matching /^qa-test/ deleted, associated files under /app/backend/uploads/resumes removed).
